name: freezer device
description: It freezes the things it touches.

name: portal gun
description: Can travel anywhere and everywhere

name: special grappling shoes
description: "you can basically just walk on any surface you want"

name: broken-leg serum
description: Heals broken legs

name: IQ-Enhancing Helmet
description: A high-tech helmet that instantly makes the wearer super-intelligent.

name: DreamBuds
description: An earpiece device that lets you enter people's dreams.

name: The Neuro-Canine Exosuit
description: A cybernetic suit integrated into a dog's body, giving it hyper-intelligence and mechanical power.

name: Volt-Breaker
description: A stun-gun-like device that shoots high-voltage electric arcs to melt metal and break chains.

name: Shrink Pad
description: A platform device that shrinks anyone standing on top of it.

name: Micro-Capsule Injector
description: A large syringe used to inject a shrunken human inside a test tube into another person's body.

name: Magnification Beam
description: A ray gun device that fires a beam to enlarge people or objects.

name: Ship-Mounted Enlarger Ray
description: A spaceship-mounted laser cannon capable of enlarging targets to planet-sized proportions.

name: Soul Liquefier & Trap
description: A device that melts alien souls and bodies, trapping their essence inside a containment box.

name: Meeseeks Box
description: A gadget that spawns a Mr. Meeseeks to fulfill a single task before vanishing.

name: Explosive Inflator Blaster
description: A ray gun that fires a red beam, inflating targets until they explode.

name: Rick Potion #9 (Official)
description: A chemical potion made from oxytocin and Morty's DNA that makes anyone touched by it fall hopelessly in love.

name: Praying Mantis Serum
description: A serum made from praying mantis DNA meant to cure the love virus, which instead turns people into praying mantis mutants.

name: Cronenberg Serum
description: A complex multi-DNA serum meant to fix the mantis mutation, which accidentally mutates humanity into grotesque Cronenberg monsters.

name: Interdimensional Travel Backpack
description: A futuristic backpack worn when permanently jumping to a new dimension to carry essential gear and equipment.

name: Rick's Laser Gun
description: Rick's iconic handheld laser pistol that fires high-energy blasts.

name: Grappling Hook Gun
description: A handheld device that fires a hooked rope to pull the user toward high places.

name: Interdimensional Cable Box(official)
description: A modified cable box that receives television broadcasts from every dimension across the multiverse.

name: Interdimensional Goggles (official)
description: "These scan your retinas, and let you view parallel time lines through genetically matching versions of your eyes" (rick)

name: Butter Robot (official)
description: A small sentient robot created by Rick for the sole purpose of passing the butter at the breakfast table.

name: Curse Scanner
description: A garage lab scanner built by Rick to detect and analyze curses on magical items sold by the Devil.

name: Curse-Purging Syringe
description: A tiny syringe filled with a liquid serum created by Rick to purge and neutralize magical curses.

name: Curse Categorizer & Analyzer
description: A scanning device that measures, categorizes, and prints out the specific type and effect of evil or curses in an object.

name: Curse-Purging Machine
description: Large scientific machines installed in Rick's shop that use advanced technology to strip away and neutralize magical curses.

name: Blue Laser Pistol
description: A classic handheld laser gun that fires blue high-energy laser blasts.

name: Brain-Downloading Device
description: A cybernetic device with scalp probes used to scan and download the complete mind and memories of a target.

name: Time-Freezing Device
description: A handheld device that completely freezes time across the universe, allowing the user to move freely while everything else remains stopped.

name: Holographic Galaxy Projector
description: A device that projects interactive 3D holographic models of galaxies into the air.

name: House Dimensional Teleporter
description: A powerful garage machine capable of teleporting Rick's entire house and yard into another dimension.

name: Kalaxian Crystal Detector
description: A handheld scanner that detects and tracks the location and distance of Kalaxian Crystals.

name: Timeline Split Monitor
description: A garage computer monitor that displays fractured timelines and quantum uncertainty split-screens.

name: Timeline Merging Remote
description: A handheld remote device used to merge fractured timelines and stabilize time.

name: Cross-Timeline Crystal Gun
description: A gun modified with a time crystal that allows it to shoot into alternate, parallel timelines.

name: Small Iron Containment Cage
description: A low-ceiling iron cage large enough for an adult human to sit inside, but too short to stand up in.

name: Time-Stabilizing Collar (official)
description: A glowing neck collar used to stabilize time and merge fractured realities back into a single timeline.

name: Yellow Pipe Wrench
description: A standard yellow pipe wrench used by Rick as an improvised weapon against the Time Cop.

name: Antimatter Gun (official)
description: A powerful custom handgun created by Rick that fires antimatter, sold to the assassin Krombopulos Michael.

name: Green Plasma-Orb Cannon
description: A ship-mounted cannon that deploys floating green plasma orbs that trap and explode pursuing enemy police ships upon contact.

name: Blue Laser Minigun
description: A heavy multi-barreled minigun that fires a relentless stream of blue laser bolts.

name: Orange Flashlight
description: An ordinary orange handheld flashlight used to illuminate dark areas.

name: Universal Throat Translator
description: A green handheld device held against the throat that synthesizes the user's voice to speak in any language.

name: Molecular Metal Fuser
description: An electrical device that seamlessly fuses iron and metal objects together without leaving any weld marks.

name: Frozen Screaming Alien
description: A creature currently in a frozen state that emits screams once thawed out.

name: Laser Disintegrator Unit
description: A laser device consisting of an emitter and receiver that incinerates any living creature touching the beam between them into ash.

name: Unfreezing Solution
description: A chemical serum that safely melts ice and thaws frozen creatures without harming them.

name: Laser Pistol
description: A compact handheld pistol that fires high-energy laser bolts.

name: Single-Button Security Watch
description: A multi-purpose wristwatch that remotely controls the house's security system, while also firing a laser beam that actually transforms living beings into snakes.

name: Phase 1 House Security System (official)
description: A Phase 1 security system that deploys heavy armor and blast shields over doors, windows, and weak entry points without using weapons.

name: Two-Handed Laser Rifle
description: A two-handed laser rifle that fires high-energy laser blasts at targets.

name: Pump-Action Purple Blaster
description: A pump-action shotgun-style rifle that fires powerful blasts of purple laser energy.

name: Blue Laser Grenade
description: A blue energy grenade that can be strapped to a chest bandolier and explodes with high-powered laser plasma.

name: Two-Handed Laser Rifle (2)
description: A two-handed laser rifle that fires high-energy laser blasts at targets.

name: Orange Laser Grenade
description: An orange energy grenade that can be strapped to a chest bandolier and explodes with high-powered plasma.

name: Snake Holster (official)
description: A leg-mounted holster specially designed to safely carry a live snake.

name: microverse battery (official)
description: A car battery containing a miniature universe whose inhabitants generate electrical power for Rick's spaceship.

name: Laser Dicing Grid
description: A ship-mounted laser security system that scans targets and slices them into precise flesh cubes.

name: Paralyzing Spine Laser
description: "A ship-mounted laser device that fires a red beam into a target's spine, permanently paralyzing them below the waist.

name: Ship-mounted laser weapons
description: A collection of laser cannons integrated into the spaceship's hull used for ship defense.

name: Psychological Attack Gestation Tube
description: A ship-mounted incubation tube that grows melting clones of loved ones to inflict emotional trauma without physical damage.

name: Ship External Loudspeaker
description: "A large external loudspeaker mounted on the spaceship to project audio to the outside environment.

name: Teenyverse Wooden Multi-Crossbow
description: A primitive wooden multi-crossbow built from alien wood and vines while trapped inside the Teenyverse.

name: Wooden Mech Suit
description: A mech suit made of wood.

name: Jet-Powered Wall-Riding Splitboard
description: A pair of shoes that transform into jet-powered splitboards to ride on walls and ceilings.

name: Car Morty (official)
description: A nanobot transformation implanted inside Morty's body that allows him to turn into a car.

name: Passenger Pure Button
description: A dashboard function on Rick's spaceship labeled 'Passenger Purge' that ejects passengers out of the ship.

name: Clone Vat (official)
description: A fluid-filled vat used by Rick to preserve and grow his cloned bodies for mind transfer.

name: Axe
description: An ordinary axe used by Rick to destroy his clone vats and terminate Operation Phoenix.

name: Inter Dimensional Cable 2
description: A modified set-top cable receiver that intercepts television broadcasts from infinite realities across the multiverse.

name: Robotic Beetle Bomb
description: A tiny robotic bug bomb carried in Rick's coat pocket that latches onto targets and disintegrates them into electric dust.

name: Intergalactic Space Phone
description: An intergalactic cell phone given to Summer that enables long-distance communication across lightyears and dimensions.

name: Local Purge Shotgun
description: A rusty, low-tech alien shotgun found on the Purge planet and used by Rick after losing his high-tech weapons.

name: Red Purge-Suit Launch Box
description: A passcode-locked red garage box (Password: 7-7-1-9-8-3-6-4-2-1-1-2) that launches power suits to the beacon receiver on the Purge planet.

name: Makeshift Purge Beacon Receiver
description: A makeshift signal receiver built by Rick from scrap items in a lighthouse to guide the Purge Suit rocket to his location.

name: Purge Suit (official)
description: A high-tech armored mech suit equipped with heavy weaponry, energy cannons, and thrusters for battlefield dominance.

name: Suit-Mounted Shock Net
description: A non-lethal electrified net deployed from the suit to shock and immobilize targets without causing lethal harm.

name: Suit-Mounted Circular Saw
description: A high-speed rotating saw blade integrated into the Purge Suit that replaces the hand for close-quarters slicing.

name: Suit-Mounted Missile Launcher
description: A missile launcher integrated into the Purge Suit's arm that fires high-explosive missiles.

name: Microscopic Monocular
description: A handheld optical device that instantly magnifies objects down to a microscopic scale.

name: Blue laser electric-firing gun
description: Used by Rick Sanchez, this lethal futuristic weapon fires a high-energy blue electric laser beam designed to directly kill targets.

name: Fake blue laser pistol
description: This fake blue laser gun fires a harmless, non-lethal blue laser beam instead of a deadly charge.

name: Rick's Dead Fly Garage Switch
description: Arranging the five dead flies on the workbench in the correct pattern retracts the everyday camouflage items and unlocks Rick's true secret underground lab.

name: Cyan Energy Laser Gun
description: A standard directed-energy sidearm that discharges concentrated light-blue laser beams. Capable of disintegrating, vaporizing, or piercing targets with lethal precision.(see 9:00 for first use)

name: Post-Apocalyptic Spiked Vehicle
description: A modified dieselpunk vehicle built to traverse desert wastelands and evade hostile scavengers. It features a custom engine intake manifold that can use high-proof alcohol as an improvised nitrous boost.

name: Isotope-322 Proximity Scanner
description: A handheld scanning device designed to track and display proximity to Isotope-322.

name: Muscle Memory Extractor & Injector
description: A syringe-like biological device capable of extracting muscle memory from biological tissue and injecting it into a recipient, instantly transferring combat skills and physical strength to the target limb.

name: Robot Replacement Wristwatch
description: A digital wristwatch designed specifically for the Robot Morty and Robot Summer decoys.

name: Isotope 322 Power Generator
description: A garage machine powered by Isotope 322 that generates and distributes electricity to the entire post-apocalyptic dimension.

name: Anti-Pickle Serum Syringe
description: A syringe filled with a chemical serum that transforms Pickle Rick back into a human.

name: Tongue-Controlled Cockroach
description: A cockroach whose brain is exposed and hijacked by Pickle Rick using his tongue to control its motor nerves and movement.

name: Cockroach Exosuit
description: An exoskeleton made entirely of cockroach limbs and parts, neural-controlled by Pickle Rick for mobility.

name: Rat Suit (official)
description: A violent exoskeleton built from rat corpses, granting Pickle Rick rat-powered arms, legs, and deadly claws.

name: Arm-Mounted Screw Gun
description: A pneumatic screw shooter integrated into the Rat Suit's arm that fires screws at high speed.

name: Pickle Rick's Jetpack
description: A makeshift jetpack built from batteries and scrap parts attached to the Rat Suit, enabling Pickle Rick to fly.

name: Rat-Head Gas Mask Hood
description: A hood and gas mask crafted from a rat's head and skull that filters out toxic fumes and smoke.

name: Pickle Rick's Battery Laser Gun
description: A high-powered laser pistol assembled by Pickle Rick using AA batteries, wires, and scavenged electronic parts.

name: Handheld Worm Extractor
description: A handheld vacuum gun that sucks small worm-like creatures into its container tube.

name: Vindicator Distress Gem
description: A glowing diamond-like gem sent by the Vindicators to project a distress signal and summon Rick for help

name: Bullet-Recycling Drone Converter
description: A square defense device that creates a circular field to catch incoming bullets, recycles them into metal discs, and deploys them as tiny turret-destroying robots.

name: Nanofiber Defense Mesh (official)
description: A bio-cybernetic defense mesh integrated into the skin that automatically electrocutes anyone who physically grabs the user's neck.

name: Neutrino Bomb (Drunken Variant)
description: A sloppy neutrino bomb built by Rick while blackout-drunk, easily defused by Morty with a pair of pliers.

name: Red Laser-Gate & Twin-Barrel Turret
description: A front-entrance defense system featuring vertical red laser bars and an overhead twin-barreled sentry turret for enemies.

name: Morphizer-XE
description: A garage device capable of altering physical body proportions, which accidentally mutates Summer into a skinless giant.

name: Morphizer-XE
description: A garage device capable of altering physical body proportions, which accidentally mutates Summer into a skinless giant.

name: Rick's Lab Coat Self-Destruct Bomb
description: A self-destruct bomb built inside Rick's lab coat that can be set on a timer and detonated.

name: Improvised Neural Beast Controller
description: A wired neural controller built from scrap parts that jabs a needle into a monster's brain to hijack and control it.

name: Poison Dart Blowgun
description: A primitive blowgun crafted from hollow alien reeds that fires venom-coated darts by blowing through the tube.

name: Cybernetic Vacuum Plunger Limb
description: A cybernetic arm attachment that fires a mini vacuum plunger to latch onto targets and pull them back.

name: Red Laser-Gate & Twin-Barrel Turret
description: A front-entrance defense system featuring vertical red laser bars and an overhead twin-barreled sentry turret for enemies.
